title: The Music of Grand Theft Auto VI: In-Game Radio Stations - Rockstar Games
summary: Soon to be broadcasting live across Leonida: the latest selection of the Grand Theft Auto series’ most distinct musical element, in-game radio stations.
text: The Music of Grand Theft Auto VI: In-Game Radio Stations - Rockstar Games Skip the Menu Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Games - Sub Menu Newswire Videos Downloads Store External Support External Get Launcher Open Search Open Player Menu Open Player Menu Newswire Grand Theft Auto VI Announcements The Music of Grand Theft Auto VI: In-Game Radio Stations Details on Six Stations from Leonida Radio, Podcasts, and More October 8, 2026 Soon to be broadcasting live across Leonida: the latest selection of the Grand Theft Auto series’ most distinct musical element, in-game radio stations. Spanning stations dedicated to everything from Classic Rock to Talk Radio, Grand Theft Auto VI players will experience the biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet. Plus, for the first time ever, Grand Theft Auto VI introduces a series of on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia to experience beyond Leonida’s terrestrial radio, with both radio and podcasts available to listen to in vehicles and on foot through newly introduced headphones and earbuds connected to their smartphones. Here’s a look at six of the stations featured in Grand Theft Auto VI: Cocoteo FM : Cocoteo FM is Leonida's home for the best of modern Latin music. Hosted by El Martillo and La Gata and featuring everything from bachata and merengue to dembow and reggaeton — Cocoteo FM is el party que nunca se apaga . Back Country Radio : MW and Delta Dawne blast renegade country music to the Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, and beyond. Stay tuned for Back Country’s roving reporter, swamp meteorologist, and Delta’s not-so-secret lover Mud Dog Mike checking in from the driver’s seat of his Grassrivers airboat. AfroBank FM : Turn up the gbedu with Burna and Palmsy, AfroBank FM's dynamic duo curating the best in African music, from 20th-century classics and undiscovered gems to contemporary sounds like amapiano, 3-step, and more. The Chamber 106.6 : Crushing metal has landed in Leonida. Jump in the pit with DJ Kerry and DJ Tom for decades of timeless metal anthems as they channel Leonida’s deep metal roots. Flash FM : The Vice City institution that delivers the best in pop music with Robyn and Alex — guaranteed to make you dance no matter where you find yourself in the Goodtime State. Dirty South Classics : A little southern hospitality from Trick and Trina, blasting regional rap and hip-hop classics. From the beach to the block, nobody reps Leonida and the South like they do. Listen to previews of these six stations at the Music section of the official site and stay tuned for more info to come, including details about Grand Theft Auto VI's dynamic score and more singles from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album . You can also pre-save Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, featuring 34 original tracks across a genre-defying roster of artists, or pre-order on vinyl and CD at gtavi-thealbum.com .
